nativeGlass.units: Android dp; tint and edge values are alpha fractions.
nativeGlass.reduced: For non-None materials: tint .94, elevation 0dp, blur 8dp; retain level edge alpha. None remains opaque with zero edge, blur and elevation.
nativeGlass.minimal: All levels: tint 1, edge 0, elevation 0dp, blur 0dp; no capture, wave backdrop decoration, artwork extraction/animation or tactileAction haptics.
nativeGlass.edge: Diagonal onSurface edge gradient: level edgeAlpha, .025, edgeAlpha * .5; 1dp stroke.
nativeGlass.capture: Only the quiet wave/artwork-colored backdrop; one owned Haze state per Android window. No capture of foreground content or other glass surfaces.
nativeGlass.eligibility: API33+ AND not low-RAM AND effects != Minimal. Otherwise the surface background is opaque.

nativeLayout.ime: Navigation hidden while IME is visible; reserve keyboard space.
nativeLayout.statistics: Bottom-aligned solid tiles; songs/artists width weights 1.4:1; gap 12dp; padding 20dp; value/label gap 4dp. Stack at large text or available width <320dp.

nativeComponents.minimumSizing: Frontmatter button/field heights are observed minimums and transport width is a maximum. Play/pause, skip, pinned artwork and search sizes are explicit. Material3 supplies defaults and states where not overridden.
nativeComponents.haptics: tactileAction requests Android CLOCK_TICK for wrapped deliberate actions, respects system haptic setting, and is disabled in Minimal. No scrolling/seeking haptic loop; not every action is wrapped.
nativeComponents.artwork: 64px software request; off-main extraction; 24-entry color-only cache; stale/cancelled result handling; brand fallback; 4.5:1 accent contrast against background/surface/variant/derived container.

home.header: Compact Onda mark/name with a 48dp Standard-glass search icon action, 24dp corners.
home.history: Statistics exist only with private local history; at most 20 unique recent songs. Song count is retained history size. Artists count filters blank names and deduplicates by artist ID; no known artists displays a dash.
home.statistics: Solid primary-container song tile (24dp corners, displaySmall count), solid surface artist tile (18dp corners, headlineLarge count); no glass or all-time-play claim.
home.collection: Your mix: Recently played / Recommended. Defaults to Recently played when history exists; it is disabled without history. Native TextButton selector, 48dp minimum, 20dp expand icon; dropdown owns Overlay glass and options expose selected semantics.
home.pinned: Existing current track first, 64dp artwork with 14dp corners, titleMedium metadata, visible In player, 48dp/22dp-corner play/pause. Metadata opens the player. Exclude the current track from ordinary collection and discovery rows.
home.rows: Plain TrackRow entries: first four, Show all/Show less toggles; expansion resets on collection change.
home.afterRows: Unequal discovery Bento, then truthful cardless friend activity.
home.scope: No featured hero or horizontal history-artwork rail; no added social/auth/saved-library/messaging backend.

player.primary: Separate Elevated island: previous/next FilledTonalIconButton 56dp with 20dp corners; PlayPauseButton 72dp with 22dp corners. Primary icon glyphs 28dp.
player.compact: The same PlayPauseButton uses 48dp with 22dp corners in MiniPlayer and Home pinned row. It is a rounded square, not CircleShape.
player.secondary: Separate cardless row: native shuffle control, real queue-count TextButton with 48dp minimum, native repeat control. Mode labels/semantics and active tint expose state.
player.seek: Cardless seek with elapsed label left and negative remaining label right; remaining label announces time remaining. Slider state still describes position/duration; disabled without duration.

browserPreview.scope: Self-contained source-derived silhouettes in the base dark palette with opaque material fallback. They do not reproduce native blur, Compose shadows, haptics, Android semantics or font scaling.
browserPreview.units: One CSS pixel represents one unscaled dp/sp solely for this panel translation. Native production values are in DESIGN.md and source.
browserPreview.font: Manrope family is requested; the browser panel uses sans-serif fallback if Manrope is not available. Native Android bundles the font.
browserPreview.states: Material-like web state layers illustrate native interaction affordances; focus-visible retains the browser user-agent outline and is not a new native focus token.
browserPreview.tonalRamps: Eight lightness steps at the extracted hue/chroma are synthesized in OKLCH only for swatch preview; they are not new native color tokens.

evidence.fixtures: 20 offline native Robolectric/Roborazzi production-component renders in .impeccable/review/*.png, including final LastWave-aligned Home/player hierarchy.
evidence.physicalAcceptance: Pending emulator/device, TalkBack, audio, haptic, frame and battery checks; host/source evidence does not imply physical acceptance.

lastWaveReference.scope: Approved Home statistics/selector/pinned-list and player primary/secondary hierarchy adaptation. Onda branding, typography, colors and native adaptive navigation retained. Reference album artwork/audio are not app assets.

narrative.overview:
Onda uses a dark content-first, editorial iOS-inspired hierarchy adapted to native Android. Immersive artwork and strong Manrope typography carry the visual emphasis. Ink and mint remain the stable identity; a playing cover can supply a readable accent. The original mark has three flowing waves.

Selective Liquid Glass gives floating playback and navigation controls a material boundary. Music rows and social content remain solid or cardless, with Bento composition reserved for discovery and statistics. Avoid excess cards, gradients, pills, shadows, icons and glass. Respect native Back behavior, touch targets, text scaling and system insets.

The approved LastWave adaptation supplies Home's statistics → collection selector → pinned playback/list hierarchy and the player's primary transport → lower modes hierarchy. Onda keeps its wave identity, typography, colors, adaptive navigation and selective glass. Attribution and the pinned GPL-3.0 reference are recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`; reference branding, cover artwork and audio are not app assets.

This is a record of the 0.4.0 production Kotlin/Compose system. Native Robolectric/Roborazzi fixtures in `.impeccable/review/` provide offline rendering evidence; they do not establish emulator/device, TalkBack, audio, haptic, frame or battery acceptance. The source tokens below use Android dp and scalable sp. Sidecar HTML/CSS is a browser-panel translation, not native acceptance evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Dark content-first layouts with a complete light theme.
Strong Manrope hierarchy and immersive artwork.
LastWave-aligned Home collections and primary/secondary player hierarchy.
Cover-derived accents with mathematical foreground contrast.
Selective glass islands for navigation, playback and overlays.
Cardless social layouts and truthful unavailable states.
Native Android behavior with Reduced and Minimal effects.

rules.name: The Content First Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces and metadata readable; use the cover accent for atmosphere and action emphasis rather than coloring every container.

rules.name: The Selective Glass Rule
rules.body: Use glass for floating navigation, playback controls, the observed search entrance/field and appropriate overlays. Keep social copy, music rows and dense settings opaque or cardless; never capture another glass surface into a backdrop.

rules.name: The Truthful State Rule
rules.body: Give empty, loading and failure states readable copy and real recovery/discovery actions; never use fabricated activity to fill a layout.

dos: **Do** lead with music artwork and readable Manrope hierarchy.
**Do** keep ink/mint as the fallback and let the current cover color the documented action roles with contrast checks.
**Do** use the original three-flowing-wave mark and restrained static backdrop contours.
**Do** preserve visible destination names, selected/action semantics, native Back behavior and system/IME insets.
**Do** honor 48dp controls, scalable text through 200%, Reduced and Minimal effects.
**Do** keep local listening and unavailable social states truthful.
**Do** label native host fixtures separately from pending device, TalkBack, audio, haptic, frame and battery verification.
donts: **Don't** add excess cards, gradients, pills, shadows, icons or glass.
**Don't** extend Bento composition beyond discovery or statistics.
**Don't** blur dense metadata, social copy or settings, or capture glass into another glass source.
**Don't** replace actual content with fake social activity, messages or unsupported action controls.
**Don't** invent custom navigation/player motion, optical refraction or physical acceptance claims.
**Don't** promote browser-side preview ramps or translated snippets into new native design tokens.
